710460101.text: Halt! The Chasm is an important location. No unauthorized personnel may enter!

710460201.text: Halt! The Chasm is sealed off. If you're an outsider, please... Oh, it's you!

710460206.text: Hahaha! Sorry for scaring you. Of course I remember you. How could I forget the person who saved my life?

710460207.text: I was only recently transferred here myself... Didn't think I'd meet you here. Guess I'm a lucky guy, eh?

710460208.text: We saved you? Did we do that?

710460209.text: Oh, come now! I was at the Jade Chamber when we fought that sea monster together. I was lightly injured and only returned to my post recently...

710460210.text: You might not remember me, but I'll never forget you. All our comrades who fought that day witnessed what you did for Liyue.

710460211.text: Could you tell me a bit about The Chasm?

710460212.text: Two years ago, an unknown incident occurred deep within the caverns and the Qixing gave the order to close the place. The miners were largely evacuated to safety.

710460213.text: It's just a shame that such a huge mine ceased production, just like that. The workers took their compensation and went their separate ways... Once such a gathering of people is dispersed, I fear it may be difficult to get them back together again.

710460214.text: ...Um, sorry, got a bit off-topic there. I believe that you must be here on important business, so I won't bother you any further. If you have any questions, just ask Muning directly. He should be at the campsite at the mine entrance.

710460215.text: Also, uh, it's not that I don't trust you or anything, but it's my job to remind you not to do anything that breaks the law!

710460216.text: Don't worry, you can trust us, come on!
